description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/sectional_volume_1d/rules/growth_lr2m_tracer_D_bin_closed (a VOLUME-CARRIED quantity: here the section dry volume m itself, NTRACER = 1) driven by problems/growth_sectional_lr2m_mms.esm, the same problem, model and resolutions as growth_sectional_lr2m_mms. The measured quantity is the relative L2 error of m at t = 0.1, the problem's only L2_error assertion at that time (the runners take the first one at assert_time, so the tracer is asserted at a different time from the number's t = 0.2 to be selectable). m is advanced by dm/dt = lam m - D(lam*m, N, V, wrt: bin), so its error measures the tracer rule's edge flux vb_edge F_N m/V on top of the number flux it carries: a first-order or wrong-donor tracer flux, or a wrong edge volume, shows up here even when the number case still passes. Sweep from NBIN = 32, where the limiter's share of the error has fallen and the pairwise orders have settled near 2.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.python: Too slow, as for growth_sectional_lr2m_mms (same problem and sweep): the python runner did not finish the NBIN = 256 sweep, and the python conformance job is disabled on main for the same reason against esm 2.x (.github/workflows/conformance.yml). Re-arm with an LSODA tolerance as tight as the 1e-13 / 1e-15 the other bindings use, once the python binding runs this sweep in CI-tolerable time.
